marc: hey all - quick bootstrap question on my M2. Installed node 18 via asdf but `npm ci` fails on node-gyp with OpenSSL include errors. Also my SSH key keeps asking passphrase after reboot. anyone have a short checklist?

anya: common mac checklist: brew openssl, export flags, reshim. e.g.
```bash
brew install openssl@1.1 pkg-config
export PATH=\"/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH\"
export CPPFLAGS=\"-I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/include\"
export LDFLAGS=\"-L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/lib\"
rm -rf node_modules && npm ci
asdf reshim nodejs
```
that usually fixes node-gyp.

marc: where should I put the exports so VS Code terminal sees them?

sasha: put PATH and brew flags in ~/.zprofile (login shells), source asdf there too: `. $HOME/.asdf/asdf.sh`. For VS Code, launch it from terminal (`open -a 'Visual Studio Code'`) or set "terminal.integrated.inheritEnv": true.

marc: ssh passphrase issue? I keep re-entering it after restart.

anya: use mac keychain: `ssh-add --apple-use-keychain ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` and add to ~/.ssh/config:
```
Host *
  AddKeysToAgent yes
  UseKeychain yes
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
```
Then restart and add key once.

infra-bot: New-hire tip: onboarding office hours Wed 10am PT in #onboarding-office-hours for live setup help. :calendar:

marc: thanks folks - node build works after exports and SSH key persisted. last bit: dotfiles - do I copy REPO_TOKEN into .envrc or use keychain?

sasha: never commit secrets. use direnv + keychain: `export REPO_TOKEN=\"$(security find-generic-password -s redwood-repo -w)\"` in local .envrc (gitignored). less risk of accidental leak.

marc: great, will do. thanks!
